title: Our History
subtitle: Four decades of representing Nigerian students across the globe.
intro: NANS Diaspora traces its roots to the broader National Association of Nigerian Students movement, which has been a powerful force in Nigerian civic life since the 1980s. The diaspora arm was formally constituted to give a unified voice to the growing number of Nigerian students pursuing education abroad.

milestones.title: Foundation
milestones.description: NANS Diaspora formally established as the international arm of the National Association of Nigerian Students, with founding chapters in the United Kingdom and the United States.

milestones.title: Continental Expansion
milestones.description: Chapters established across Europe and North America, with the first Pan-African Diaspora Student Summit held in London.

milestones.title: Institutional Recognition
milestones.description: NANS Diaspora formally recognised by the Nigerian Federal Government as the official representative body for Nigerian students abroad.

milestones.title: Global Growth
milestones.description: Membership surpasses 30,000 students across 30 countries. The Homecoming & Community Development Initiative launched.

milestones.title: Digital Transformation
milestones.description: NANS Diaspora launches its digital platform, enabling virtual chapter meetings, online elections, and global member connectivity during the COVID-19 pandemic.

milestones.title: 50,000 Members
milestones.description: NANS Diaspora reaches a milestone of 50,000 registered members across 40+ countries and 120+ chapters worldwide.
